protocol.source: VLA_MUI_HUB right-16x32; first policy inference per episode
protocol.target: client actions[0], complete 10x7 chunk, official checkpoint-std normalized
protocol.feature_site: HB-MLP/gate inputs after layer attention at layers 2-5, d0, action tokens 1-10

feature_pooling.hidden: mean over HB2-5 and ten action tokens
feature_pooling.router_probs_pooled32: mean over HB2-5 and ten action tokens
feature_pooling.router_probs_layer_resolved128: mean over ten action tokens only; concatenate HB2-5

protocol.flow_noise_reconstruction: np.random.default_rng(flow_noise_seed).standard_normal((10,24)).astype(float32); identity was enforced by the capture server
protocol.router_probability_preprocessing: clamp decoded fp16 full probabilities to nonnegative and L1-normalize every layer/denoise/token site before pooling
protocol.feature_centering: candidate-center and scalar-RMS scale separately within each K32 pool; feature-only transductive operation
protocol.main_cv: within-task leave-one-init-state-pool-out; inner state-group CV selects ridge alpha
protocol.seed_disjoint_cv: sorted seeds modulo 4; each held state x held 8-seed block predicted from other 15 states x other 24 seeds; target means use allowed 24 only; feature centering remains transductive over K32
protocol.seed_disjoint_evaluation: pair distances only within held8; PAM K2 independently per held8 then union K8; exact random baseline independently draws two per fixed fold
protocol.action_vote: ordinary unweighted true-action medoid within selected K8; no cluster weights
protocol.vote_regret: (K32 global mean distance of selected-K8 vote - K32 global-medoid mean distance) / median K32 pair distance
protocol.random_coverage: exact combinatorial expectation over all uniform K8 subsets
protocol.stratified_random_coverage: exact survival-function expectation for two uniform candidates from each fixed held8 fold

subset_definitions.mixed40: 0 < eventual episode successes < 32 within a state pool
subset_definitions.balanced16: 4 <= eventual episode successes <= 28; balanced-min4, not a 16/16 split
